topic: how Visa keeps more than half of every dollar of its revenue as profit
storyAngle: Visa sits in the middle of every card swipe and keeps an unusually large slice of what it brings in.
doNotClaim: Fiscal 2024 means the year ended September 30, 2024.
Net income is after all costs and taxes; do not call it a cut of what shoppers spend.
Do not say what merchants or banks pay per swipe.

facts.claim: Visa fiscal 2024 net revenue was $35,926 million.
say: thirty five point nine billion dollars

facts.claim: Visa fiscal 2024 GAAP net income was $19.7 billion.

derived.claim: Net income was about 55% of net revenue (19.7 / 35.9): about fifty five cents of profit on every dollar of revenue.
